scenes.big: Can you read your eye power?
scenes.say: Can you read your own eye power card? Let's decode it.

scenes.en: Right eye and left eye. Sometimes written OD and OS.
scenes.say: R E and L E mean right eye and left eye. Some cards say O D and O S.

scenes.en: Minus = far things blur. Plus = near things blur.
scenes.ta: மைனஸ் தூரப் பார்வை, பிளஸ் அருகில் பார்வை
scenes.say: S P H is your main power. Minus means far things blur. Plus usually means near things are harder.

scenes.en: Corrects astigmatism (uneven eye curve). AXIS is its direction, 0 to 180.
scenes.say: Cylinder power corrects astigmatism, an uneven curve in the front of the eye. The axis, from zero to one eighty, is its direction.

scenes.en: Extra power for reading. Did you know? Most people need it after about 40.
scenes.say: Add is extra power for reading. Did you know? Most people need it after about forty.

scenes.en: Distance between your pupils, in mm. It centres your lenses.
scenes.say: P D is the distance between your pupils, in millimetres. It centres your lenses, so always ask for it.

scenes.en: Power can change. Re-check every 1 to 2 years, or sooner if vision blurs.
scenes.say: Powers change, so recheck every one to two years, or sooner if vision blurs.
